_note: Logistics zone. Every physical good lives in some building's own store, and nothing moves unless a porter carries it (systems/resources/stores.js, systems/haulage/). Depots and storehouses hold any mix of goods up to their capacity; repair crews and builders draw their materials from them. Porters live at a porter station, are hired there, and wait there when they have no route.

buildings.name: Depot
buildings._note: A cage of shelves off the landing. Small, cheap, and wherever it is needed: a depot beside the canteens shortens every food run.

buildings.name: Storehouse
buildings._note: The Shaft's common store. Repair crews and builders take their parts and materials from here, nearest first — a part still in the workshop is not yet a part anyone can use.

buildings.name: Porter station
buildings._note: Where porters are hired, where they rest, and where they wait when nobody has told them what to carry. Each station houses porterStation.porters of them.
